title: Lip Service v1 (plain)
comment: A pitch-bend and CC1 demo, a 24-bar jump blues in Bb at 168 BPM, swung. Bars 1-12 are the head: trumpet riffs with scoops, falls, and a shake, answered by a sax section that falls and doits together. Bars 13-24 are a trumpet solo with shakes, a blue-note lip bend, a long fall off a high Bb, and a held high Bb with delayed vibrato over the stop-time ending. This is the plain version, with the same notes and velocities and no automation.
